## Services
- A/C Repair: When the house is heating up, you want a real person to answer. Customers describe calls returned right away, Sunday visits and fixes by the next day — from electrical issues and damaged copper lines to a clogged system.
- A/C & Heat Pump Installation: Replacing a worn-out system? You’ll get the options laid out plainly, a price that includes the labor, and a clean, by-the-book install — reviewers mention next-day installs and being shown how the new unit works.
- Heating & Air Handlers: Jacksonville winters are short, but a cold snap still finds a weak system. Air Element installs heating systems and air handlers — sealed, strapped and plumbed neatly in closets, garages and attics.
- Duct Work: Comfort only reaches the room if the air does. From attic flex runs to open-truss commercial builds, Air Element lays out and installs duct systems that move air where it’s needed.
- Ductless Mini-Splits: Enclosed a patio, added a room or finished a space the ducts don’t reach? A ductless mini-split adds quiet, independent comfort — wall head inside, compact condenser outside.
- Commercial & Rooftop: Their business card says it plainly: residential and commercial. That includes packaged units, rooftop equipment and commercial condensers serviced up on the roof or out back.
